richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bijapur

c: Bijapur, now officially Vijayapura, is a district town in the dry north of Karnataka, famous for the Gol Gumbaz and its other Adil Shahi monuments. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bijapur to schools, colleges, municipal gardens, government campuses and residential layouts. The Fun Fitness machines are built at our factory in Vasai, about 410 km away, and delivered by road.

Rainfall in this part of Karnataka is low and the sun is strong for most of the year. That is hard on outdoor colours, and cheap plastic can turn chalky within a couple of summers. Our seats, handles and footplates are roto-moulded and come in more than 15 shades, and lighter shades show less fading and stay cooler to touch. The galvanised frames handle the dry heat well. Dust is the main maintenance task here, so plan for a weekly wipe and a regular check of the moving parts.

items.q: Will the colours fade in Bijapur's sun?
items.a: Roto-moulded parts are made for outdoor use, but every colour softens over years of strong sun. Lighter shades show it least. The 3-year warranty covers manufacturing defects in roto-moulded parts.

items.q: Do you supply Vijayapura and nearby towns?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to Vijayapura and other towns in north Karnataka, and install with our own team or a dealer.

items.q: What base do the machines need?
items.a: A firm, level base. On open soil we grout the posts into concrete. On a paved surface some machines can be self-standing. We confirm the method for each site.
